learning_outcomes.text: Provide students with basic English language knowledge.
Provide students with basic English reading skills.
Provide students with basic English vocabulary knowledge.

syllabus_topics: General information about the course and course notes
Explaining simple present and past tenses and reinforcing the topic with exercises, improving note-taking skills by distinguishing keywords and main ideas through listening exercises

Explaining 'should/shouldn't; it's + adjective + infinitive structures and reinforcing with exercises, associating with cultures topic and creating dialogues. Improving understanding of words in context through texts. Improving note-taking skills for main ideas and details through listening exercises.
A brief introduction to Gerunds/infinitives, giving example dialogues to express opinions, associating with food topic and creating dialogues.
A brief introduction to Gerunds/infinitives, giving example dialogues to express opinions, associating with food topic and creating dialogues.
Explaining prepositions of time and place and related exercises, explaining directions and associating the topic with prepositions, creating maps and dialogues about directions.

Learning to express new linguistic structures both in terms of ideas and in terms of agreeing and disagreeing with ideas. Explaining the topic of Infinitive & Gerund in more detail and reinforcing with exercises. Homework: Gerund & Infinitive worksheet, Listening worksheet (Netflix - Our Planet S01 E03).

Explaining adjectives, the function of prefixes in word elements 'un-' and '-less' and reinforcing with exercises, associating with themselves and Social Networks topic and creating dialogues. Homework: Listening worksheet (Netflix - Our Planet S01 E04).

Practicing pronunciation of word elements, improving note-taking skills for keywords through listening exercises. Homework: Creating sentences using new vocabulary learned in class. Listening worksheet (Netflix - Our Planet S01 E08).

Teaching daily expressions and vocabulary by associating with Thanksgiving and Black Friday topics, reinforcing vocabulary learning with reading exercises, writing exercises in the target language using new vocabulary learned. Homework: Writing Activity.

Teaching vocabulary by associating with Cultures topic, reinforcing vocabulary learning with listening exercises, discussing and sharing ideas about different cultures. Writing exercises in the target language using new vocabulary learned. Homework: Listening & Writing Worksheet.

Teaching vocabulary by associating with Traveling topic, reinforcing vocabulary learning with listening exercises. Writing exercises in the target language using new vocabulary learned. Homework: Regarding Writing and Vocabulary Learning.
Explaining word formation processes using prefixes and suffixes.
Explaining Conditionals - if clause (Conditional sentences) and reinforcing with exercises. Homework: Conditionals Worksheet.
